Alexa: OK serious question — who else got absolutely wrecked by the underdog this weekend? My RB2 outscored my entire starting WR corps. 😭
Matt: same. bench player from the waiver wire popped off. wild. :exploding_head: 
Sarah: @Alexa are you still running that 2-RB flex strategy? time to rethink.
Alexa: I was. stubbornness + bad matchups = 😅
Josh: waiver chaos incoming. I just put in a blind claim for K. Barnes — fingers crossed.
Eva: reminder — waiver deadline tonight at 11:59pm PST. league-bot will lock claims at 1782345712.
league-bot: Waiver window closes tonight 11:59pm PST. Claims processed 00:00am UTC.
Sarah: who should I target if I want a safe floor? looking to stop the bleeding in the middle of my roster.
Matt: pick up a dart-throw RB with good volume, not necessarily sexiest name. I like J. Herrera this week.
Alexa: I grabbed Herrera last week and he was fine. also consider a rookie with snap share creeping up.
Josh: anyone want to trade for my busted TE? offering TE + bench for a WR. no takers yet.
Eva: @Josh post it in #fantasy-trades, more eyes there.
Matt: Poll — biggest upset of the weekend? reply with 1/2/3
Sarah: 1 (Underdog team A>Team B)
Alexa: 2 (Pick-em gone wrong)
Josh: 3 (My QB benching himself with injury scare)
Eva: 2 :grimacing:
Matt: vote tally so far — 2 is winning.
Alexa: also lol at the guy who dropped a top-15 WR for a kicker last week. criminal.
Sarah: link to box score: https://espn.example/boxscore/abc123 (not real)
Josh: waiver priority update: 4 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3. may be worth putting a claim in even if it's second choice.
Alexa: true. gamble or wait?
Matt: gamble. the ones who wait always miss the breakout.
Eva: FYI league-bot will DM final claim status after processing. good luck y'all :crossed_fingers:
Alexa: good luck — may your start/sit decisions be merciful this week.
